name: 21047 · Fallston, MD
findings: ZIP 21047 (Fallston) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21047 (Fallston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
